items.item_text: Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent combination of education and experience
Minimum of 5 years as a project lead in a business/admin unit within a basic science/clinical department or service line

The Department of Medicine is seeking a highly organized and collaborative Program Manager to support the planning, development, and execution of program operations in alignment with organizational goals and objectives. In this role, you will oversee day-to-day program activities, coordinate strategic initiatives, manage deliverables, and support continuous program growth and success.

Key responsibilities include program planning and implementation, stakeholder communication, staff supervision and training, financial oversight, grant writing, and ensuring compliance with UCLA, state, and federal regulations. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrate strong organizational and leadership skills, and effectively collaborate with internal teams and external partners to achieve program objectives.
This is a 25% limited role which may convert to career*
Understanding of strategic leadership, planning, and change management approaches in a complex environment, preferably a research-intensive medical school/health system
Understanding of financial planning concepts as they pertain to academic health care, research, and higher education
Ability to demonstrate an entry level of diplomacy in persuading and influencing people at various levels to achieve results
Ability to identify and analyze pertinent information and data to make and communicate recommendations and decisions
Ability to serve as a partner in maintaining a culture of integrity and accountability
Ability to serve as a receptive listener who seeks to understand differing sides of each situation
Demonstrated ability to communicate medical, policy, and administrative information in English
